chapter.section:
Official Server Rules
1. Do NOT have long-term projects in a Mining Dimension. (It could reset at any time.)
2. The End Dimension is not safe to build in as it could be reset at any time.
2.1(It doesn't reset often at all but build with that in mind.)
3. Common sense/maturity.
4. Do NOT chunkload too many chunks.
5. Use a Mining Dimension if you’re going to Quarry large areas that dig out chunks! (If available.)
5.1) The Nether is fine to use to "quarry out large areas" aswell.
6. No griefing.
7. Any sort of "cheat" is prohibited. (X-Ray etc.)
8. Playing on two of your own accounts on the same server to gain an advantage is not allowed.
9. If FTB Chunks is installed, do NOT make oversized claims when it's not needed.
9.1) Admins will reduce if any are found.
10. Moving Lootr Chests from their generated location(s) is not allowed. Do NOT move them.
10.1) One or two is allowed. If an excess amount are found, they will be deleted.
11. Remove Lootr Chests from their generated location(s) only if absolutely necessary.
11.1) For example: If it's in the way of where you're going to build.
12. No stealing.
13. No spamming.
14. No scamming other players.
15. Be appropriate.
16. Respect others.
17. Try not to swear.
18. Do not harrass.
19. No racism.
20. No threatening.
21. No trolling.
22. No plotting.
23. No advertising or mentioning other servers.
24. No begging. But asking nicely once or twice is acceptable!
25. Don’t exploit any issues you might find in mods, like duping.
26. No blatant lag "machines"!
Please respect the rules. Bans could be handed out without any warnings!
If you broke a rule and an action was made towards you. Complaining or similar won't do anything.
Most decisions are final, exceptions are made on some occasions.
Have fun!
- Gbergz, TNP Team.
